item.title: Go on Linux and CVE-2026-98432: Patch Your Kernel
Measuring Go 1.28's HTTP/2 'Parking' Memory Savings
item.description: I benchmarked Go 1.28 HTTP/2 parking with 5,000 idle connections. Across three runs, the same server binary used 85-93 MiB less RSS with parking enabled. (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Our Response To The eMudhra Key Disclosure Incident
item.description: How the Go team responded to the eMudhra certificate compromise with our first-ever URGENT track security release. (3 sources: goblog, golangweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Wails 3.0: Build Desktop Apps with Go and Native Web Views
item.description: Wails v3.0.0 is here: multiple windows, system tray, native menus, services and generated bindings, an updater, mobile support and a new documentation site. (1 source: golangweekly)
